# INZON Times and Gifts

> INZON Times and Gifts is a B2B wholesale supplier and private label partner for custom-branded corporate gifts and promotional merchandise in Kerala, India. INZON sources products from manufacturers and suppliers, brands them with your logo, and supplies them in bulk to companies and institutions. Minimum order quantity is 100 units. Delivery covers all of Kerala.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.inzongifting.com/): Who INZON is, what it supplies, who it serves, and how to request a quote.
- [About](https://www.inzongifting.com/about/): Company background, how INZON works as a supplier, and contact details.
- [All products](https://www.inzongifting.com/products/): Catalogue of gift sets, bottles and flasks, bags, apparel, caps, pens, keychains, wall clocks and home accessories that can be branded.
- [Blog](https://www.inzongifting.com/blog/): Practical buying guides for corporate gifts in bulk.
- [Employee onboarding kits guide](https://www.inzongifting.com/blog/employee-onboarding-kits-kerala/): What to put in a welcome kit for 100+ new joiners, how to brand it and how far ahead to order.

## Ordering facts
- Buyers: companies and institutions ordering in bulk (not individual consumers)
- Minimum order quantity: 100 units
- Payment terms: 100% before delivery
- Delivery area: all Kerala
- Invoicing: GST invoice (GSTIN 32ABRFM8059P1ZC)
